links.outcome: MLLM diagnostic accuracy and sensitivity for diabetic retinopathy detection and grading on fundus images
links.effect: Binary DR detection sensitivity: ChatGPT 0.539, Perplexity 0.488, Claude 0.179, Gemini 0.042. Severity grading accuracy 0.314-0.411, sensitivity 0.184-0.247. Performance short of clinical standards.
links.quote: Currently, however, there is variability in the accuracy of image analysis, and diagnostic performance falls short of clinical standards for safe implementation in DR diagnosis and grading.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and safety profile of commercial multimodal foundation models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5, Llama 3.1) on diabetic retinopathy classification from fundus photos using automated benchmarking.
